projects.title: SIEM + FIM Platform
projects.description: A security monitoring platform combining SIEM and file integrity monitoring, built from scratch - custom agents that collect and forward events from endpoints to a central server that aggregates logs, tracks file integrity, and surfaces unauthorized changes. Currently in active development.

projects.title: Password Manager
projects.description: A Django password vault built to do credential storage right: JWT authentication, Fernet encryption at rest, breach detection, and role based admin controls for users, roles, and password policies.

projects.title: File Integrity Monitoring System
projects.description: A real time file integrity monitor that baselines critical files and directories, watches for unauthorized changes, and raises alerts on any modification, addition, or deletion to support tamper detection.

projects.title: Phishing Email Detection
projects.description: A machine learning classifier that flags phishing emails in real time, analyzing headers, sender behavior, and message content with a Random Forest model and TF-IDF feature extraction.

projects.title: Network Port Scanner
projects.description: A Python network reconnaissance tool for security assessments, implementing multiple TCP/IP scan types to identify open ports and active hosts and map potential attack surfaces.

projects.title: Store Management Portal
projects.description: A full stack store management platform with a React frontend and Django REST backend, featuring role based access control, inventory tracking, and real time data sync - the backend depth behind the security work.
